layer.platform: what every app runs on: cluster policy, operators, shared services, cloud accounts, identity, networking, and the templates apps use to get them.
layer.app: software that does work people use, and its data, agents and jobs (Hermes, gbrain, Hindsight, collectors, agent harnesses).

target.cloud: lands at a cloud provider (Cloudflare, Google).
target.registry: builds or changes a container image or Helm chart.
target.none: design, planning or coordination, or work a person wants to steer in their own thread.
